senses.gloss: m. (עֲלַל, infin. מֵיעַל; cmp. בִּיאָה II) coming in, entering.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Exodus 21:10">Targ. Y. II, Ex. XXI, 10</cite> [read:] <he>מֵיעֲלֵיה ומיפקיה לוותה</he> his visiting her (for marital duties); [Y. I <he>מעייל לה</he> read: <he>מֵיעֲלֵיה לה</he> or <he>מְעַיְּילֵיה</he> (fr. <cite ref="P00241"><he>עוּל</he></cite>)].—
Keth. 53ᵃ מֵעֲלָאִי דידי my very coming in (with you).—Pl. constr. מֵעֲלֵי, מֵי׳, מַעֲ׳.—מ׳ שמשא sunset. [Dan. VI, 15 מֵעָלֵי, ed. Baehr מַעֲלֵי.]—
Targ. Y. II, Num. XXV, 4.—מ׳ שבתא, מ׳ (יומא ד)פסחא &c. Sabbath eve (Friday), Passover eve &c. Ib. XXII, 28.—
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 14:13">Targ. Y. Gen. XIV, 13</cite>.—
<cite ref="Ketubot 62b:1">Keth. 62ᵇ</cite> <he>כל מ׳ יומא וכ׳</he> every eve of the Day of Atonement.
